title: Trump Administration Reviews About $9 Billion in Harvard Federal Funding
description_short: Trump Administration Reviews About $9 Billion in Harvard Federal Funding
description_medium: On March 31, 2025, the Trump administration announced a review of roughly $9 billion in federal grants and contracts to Harvard, citing allegations of antisemitism. Broader demands concerning university governance and policy followed in April, after which funding was frozen. The review and later freeze were separate actions, not one February threat.
description_long: On March 31, 2025, the Trump administration announced a review of roughly $9 billion in federal grants and contracts to Harvard over allegations of antisemitism, according to the supplied Reuters summary. The figure described funding under review, not money already canceled that day. In April, the administration made broader demands concerning university governance and policy, and funding was later frozen. Separating those steps matters: the March announcement was a review of federal grants and contracts, while the later demands and freeze represented subsequent actions. The packet does not identify the grants affected, the exact terms of the April demands, or the final outcome of each funding action. It does correct the stored February chronology: the $9 billion review began March 31, and the broader governance demands and funding freeze came later. The evidence supports a dated account of the review and a later escalation, without treating them as a single threat or assuming the full amount was ultimately canceled.

preserved_fields.title: Trump Administration Reviews About $9 Billion in Harvard Federal Funding
preserved_fields.description_short: Trump Administration Reviews About $9 Billion in Harvard Federal Funding

notes: The supplied correction supports a March 31, 2025 review of about $9 billion in grants and contracts and distinguishes it from broader April demands and the later funding freeze. The linked Reuters report is the source for the dated review; the packet does not specify affected grants or final outcomes, so those are not claimed.
